entries.1450286a028e1fdb: In the fiscal year ended March 2026, new openings followed one after another in Japan, including three Capricciosa stores, one Wolfgang's Steakhouse store, one Tim Ho Wan store and two Sarabeth's stores, and revenue in the Japan segment rose 12.8% from the previous year to ¥26,358 million. Growth is centered on new store openings in Japan.
